'''Magister Ala'shor Sunblood''' is a [[high elf]] [[mage trainer]] located in [[Brinthilien]] in the [[Thalassian Highlands]]. In addition to his role as a Magister of Quel'Thalas, he is a noble of House Sunblood.<ref>[[Magister's Letter]]</ref>

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Ever since the Sunwell fell, we've strained to minimize the amount of mana we expend. We used to be paragons of arcane power; now, we are a mere shadow of our former selves.
